load_image_from_path: load an image from a file path and return it as a normalized numpy array with optional alpha channel support
load_depth_from_file: load a depth map from an EXR or 16-bit PNG file and apply a scale adjustment factor
get_bbox_from_mask: extract a bounding box in xywh format from a numpy mask array using a configurable threshold value
resize_image_tensor: resize a numpy array or torch tensor image to target dimensions using bilinear interpolation and return a mask
load_pointcloud_cached: load a point cloud from a file path with LRU caching and optional subsampling to a maximum point count
